NCAA D1.name: United Soccer Coaches NCAA Division I Women final poll
NCAA D1.note: Rank order is the December 9, 2025 final poll. Records for schools in the August 4, 2026 preseason poll are that page's final 2025 records. Baylor and BYU records are from the Wikipedia compilation of the same December 9 poll.

NCAA D2.name: United Soccer Coaches NCAA Division II Women final poll
NCAA D2.note: National poll 11, December 16, 2025. Records are the final 2025 records printed on that poll.

NCAA D3.name: United Soccer Coaches NCAA Division III Women final poll
NCAA D3.note: Rank order is the December 9, 2025 final poll. Records are the final 2025 records on the August 4, 2026 preseason poll, whose previous-rank column matches that final order.

NAIA.name: NAIA Women's Soccer Coaches' Top 25 postseason poll
NAIA.note: Postseason poll released December 17, 2025, after the national championship. The Kansas Collegiate Athletic Conference republished the NAIA national-office poll in full.

NJCAA.name: United Soccer Coaches NJCAA Division I Women final poll
NJCAA.note: The August 4, 2026 preseason poll lists 19 teams, previous ranks 1-19, and states that the records shown are final 2025 records. The page does not print a separate December dateline, so the source date is the page date.
